positions.wants: A smaller wedding of about 150 close family and friends
A bigger gathering of 350 so relatives and neighbours aren't left out
A banquet hall, for the comfort of elders
To keep the total within a firm limit
A generous celebration, even if it costs more

options.title: Intimate wedding, big Bou Bhaat
options.description: Keep the Biye close at 150 guests and welcome the wider circle of 350 at Bou Bhaat. The couple get their quiet ceremony and every relative is still invited to celebrate.

options.title: Meet in the middle at 300
options.description: Invite 300 guests to both the Biye and Bou Bhaat. Everyone moves a little; the venue can be agreed separately, for example a hall with an adjoining lawn.

options.title: Keep the guest list as it is
options.description: Change nothing for now. The numbers stay where they are, and the family can agree the venue style separately.
